The non-steam-driven auxiliary loads use electricity imported from the grid. Note that the “CO Capture & Compression” category for Case 1 includes power demand 2 for the Shell ADIP-Ultra Pre-Combustion CO capture system, which purifies the syngas for 2 ammonia production and vents CO to the atmosphere instead of capturing it. Case 3 has the 2 largest power requirement (164 MWe) and Case 1 has the smallest power requirement (75 MW) of all cases. The largest contributors to the power requirements are ammonia production, air compressors, and the air separation unit. Air separation equipment includes the main air compressor, booster compressor, and oxygen pump. For Case 1, the auxiliary load is the smallest due to the large amount of available steam that is used to drive the ammonia plant compressors and refrigeration systems as well as the air compressor.
